build_image_stack: build an ImageStack to manage image-to-worker assignment across multiple models for crowdsourcing evaluations
get_next_image_from_stack: get the next image and model assignment for a worker from the ImageStack ensuring no duplicates
remove_worker_from_stack: remove a worker from the ImageStack and adjust the pointer to reassign their incomplete evaluations
serialize_bot_message: serialize a bot message dict by converting Metric objects to their scalar values for JSON compatibility
get_image_src: get a base64-encoded data URI string from a PIL Image or file path for use in HTML img tags
